pages.title: Djinni Crystallizer
pages.text: The djinni crystallizer is faster and more efficient, doubling the speed of processing and increasing the output amount from gem ores.$(br2)They also can deconstruct amethyst and quartz blocks.$(br)

pages.title: Filters
pages.text: This spirit already only picks up items it has recipes for.$(br)Put a $(item)list filter$() or $(item)attribute filter$() into its filter slot to further restrict which valid inputs it will take.$(br)See Spirit Filters for filter details.$()
